messages:
alisa: Heads up — got three advisories that touch the inference runtime: sentencepiece (0.1.95 -> potential CVE), protobuf (23.3.4 -> parsing vuln), and a FlashAttention kernel edge-case that can cause a crash/privilege escalation under crafted inputs. Affects hosted + Dedicated GPU pools. Need triage + patch window. :warning:

mike: On it. Can you paste the exact affected versions and CVE IDs? Also quick Q: do we need KMS key rotation for model artifacts or just audit/unwrap keys?

alisa: CVE IDs in my ticket but TL;DR: sentencepiece: CVE-2025-0456 (low/remote parsing), protobuf: CVE-2025-0789 (medium, malformed message parsing), FlashAttention kernel: CVE-2025-1010 (high, kernel OOB on long seqs -> potential escalation). KMS: we don't need to rotate model CEKs, but we must ensure HSM unwrap ops are logged and retain audit log for 90d during patch window.

sarah: ML note — model weights are fine. FlashAttention issue can cause OOM/crash for long sequences or adversarial inputs; impacts throughput p95 and can trigger SLO breaches. Recommend staging validation with long-seq synthetic traces. Canary before full rollout.

dan: For rollout we'll need temporary RBAC elevation for infra to push kernel hotpatch to the Dedicated pools. Who signs off on 2h elevation? Also need to ensure audit logging includes who deployed and which key was used to sign the image.

alisa: I'll request a short RBAC exception: mike + dan for 2h starting at patch time. Patch plan (draft):
1) staging validation (image + pip wheel tests)
2) deploy canary to 5% Dedicated (separate pool) for 30m
3) monitor metrics (errors, p95 latency, OOMs)
4) if pass, phased rollout to remaining Dedicated then Hosted (gradual)
5) fallback: auto-route to quantized model variant if kernel-level crash detected
6) rollback plan (image tag + config revert)

mike: I'll create the rollout config. Basic smoke commands for validation:
```
# staging container build
docker build -t rwinf/runtime:patch-20250315 .
# pip upgrades for userland libs
pip install --upgrade sentencepiece==0.1.96 protobuf==23.3.5
# canary deploy (example)
redwoodctl deploy --image rwinf/runtime:patch-20250315 --pool dedicated-canary --instances 10 --strategy canary
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by mike for 2025-03-15T14:00:00Z (10 instances). Auto-rollback triggers: >2% error rate or >5% latency regression p95.

sarah: I'll run the inference smoke suite overnight against staging (1k long-seq + mixed batch sizes). Also will add an adversarial long-seq fuzz test. Will post results by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

dan: KMS/audit actions: during patch window set unwrap logging to verbose and stream to audit-bucket. Need retention policy for 90 days and ensure SIEM ingest. I'll file a infra change with the audit team.

alisa: I'll open SEC ticket and calendar invite for tomorrow 14:00-16:00 UTC. Will include runbook, rollback steps, and post-deploy QA checklist. @mike @sarah pls ack if you can join the window. :thumbsup:

mike: Ack, I'll be available for the window and will own rollout config + RBAC request.

sarah: Ack, will monitor metrics and run smoke tests during canary.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Calendar invite & ticket created: SEC-2025-112 — Inference runtime third-party deps patch. Patch window 2025-03-15 14:00-16:00 UTC.

alisa: Perfect. After canary I'll open a short postmortem template in the ticket regardless of outcome. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
